 elif n<65536: hdr += bytes([0x80|126])+struct.pack('"'!H'"',n)
 else: hdr += bytes([0x80|127])+struct.pack('"'!Q'"',n)
 enc=bytes(data[i]"'^mask[i%4] for i in range(n))

 data=b''
